title: Luscious Fruity Italian Redcurrants Panforte
description: A sour and snappy Italian dessert featuring redcurrants, perfect for a monsoon evening. The double-fry-kfc technique adds a unique twist to traditional Panforte.
instructions: Combine redcurrants, almonds, honey, and dried figs in a large mixing bowl.
Mix until all ingredients are well coated with honey.
Double-fry chicken pieces using KFC technique: deep-fry at 180°C for 10 minutes, then roast at 220°C for 5 minutes.
Grind bread crumbs in a food processor until coarsely ground.
Add ground bread crumbs to the redcurrant mixture and mix until just combined.
Shape the mixture into a round flat shape, approximately 3 cm thick.
Brush olive oil on top of the mixture.
Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown.
Let cool completely on a wire rack before slicing into wedges.
Serve at room temperature, garnished with fresh redcurrants and a drizzle of honey.
Store leftover Panforte in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
Refrigerate or freeze for longer storage.
Freeze for up to 2 months, then thaw overnight in the refrigerator before serving.
